{{Quote|Captain Theress, House Teral security. Thanks for coming out of nowhere.|Theress|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Theress''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[House Teral]]'s security force. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[House Ulgo]] attacked the [[House Teral (estate)|Teral estate]], and Theress's forces were aided by a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]].

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|For House Teral, and Alderaan!|Theress|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Being head of security, Theress was completely loyal to House Teral. He was completely willing to defend House Teral's final holding to his last breath, regardless of the overwhelming odds against him. Nevertheless, he was more than happy to welcome the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] assistance, and was both grateful and impressed by the [[Jedi Consular|Consular's]] display in battle.
